newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Everbright-IHD eyes bank, Theme stake.
newsitem.headline: Everbright-IHD eyes bank, Theme stake.

text.p: China Everbright-IHD Pacific Ltd said on Thursday its strategy of becoming a broader-based conglomerate would include taking a stake in Everbright Bank of China and changing the structure of its investment in retailing.
Everbright-IHD was raising about HK$1.9 billion through a placement of shares, the company said in announcement.

The company said it would use the proceeds to repay about HK$380 million in shareholders' loans and may apply the balance or some portion of the proceeds to buy a 20 percent interest in Everbright Bank if approvals for such a purchase are received.

Everbright-IHD expressed an interest in acquiring a stake in the Beijing-based bank in early 1997. Both Everbright-IHD and Everbright Bank are ultimately members of the China Everbright Group, which is controlled by China's State Council.
Relevant government approvals, needed for such an acquisition, have been requested but not yet received, it said.
Everbright Bank of China had staff of 1,500 at the end of 1996 and 13 branches in China including its headquarters in Beijing.

The bank reported pre-tax profit of about 890 million yuan for the year ended in December 1996 and about 451 million yuan in 1995, and had total assets of 47 billion yuan at the end of last year, according to Chinese accounting standards.
The bank was preparing audited financial statements according to international accounting standards, it said.
No negotiations have yet been conducted on price or any other terms of any potential acquisition of the bank by the company and no agreements reached, it added.
Everbright-IHD also announced plans to reduce its stake in its major retailing operation in Singapore, through a share swap with Theme International Holdings.

"On-going negotiations have been conducted by the directors since mid-May with Theme International Holdings regarding a possible strategic investment by the company of approximately 20 percent of the enlarged issued capital of Theme," it said.
Theme is a Hong Kong-based casual wear maker and retailer.
Everbright-IHD planned to acquire the Theme shares at a price of HK$3.10 per share, the statement said. Theme shares closed at HK$4.225 on May 23, prior to their suspension from trading on May 26.
Trading in shares of Everbright-IHD resumed on Thursday, while Theme shares remained suspended.

Proposals under discussion include Everbright-IHD paying for its Theme stake by inviting Theme to take a majority stake in Emporium Holdings (Singapore) Ltd, in which Everbright-IHD controls 99 percent of the voting rights.
The balance of the consideration will be about HK$50 million, which Everbright-IHD will meet using internal resources, the statement said.
Emporium reported a loss of HK$29.6 million in 1996, with its turnover accounting for 89.7 percent of Everbright-IHD's turnover of HK$1.54 billion.

The company said if the Theme transaction is completed on the terms currently under negotiation, the company will retain a minority interest in Emporium. Everbright-IHD's accounts would show a 20 percent contribution from Emporium and 20 percent from Theme, it said.

The statement said the net effect of the transaction would be a reduction in Everbright-IHD's turnover and that the company does not believe its remaining interest in Emporium would represent a material portion of its net income going forward.
